comments.body:
It’s not at all uncommon to have two bachelor’s degrees. It’s a thing in Europe that leads to two different degrees. In America, it would just be two majors, and you’d still have just that one degree. If you like math, I’d highly recommend that you don’t restrict yourself and do it. 

To answer your question - it won’t definitely decrease your chances of getting into that MSc program at ETHZ. It will have either a positive impact - had I been in an AdCom, why wouldn’t I want a CS master’s student that also happen to have studied math and is good at it? - or no impact at all - the chances of this is very low if you do good.
comments.author: 5Lick
